objective: Engineering risk under-rates changes whose paths are not exactly repo-relative. server/domain/engineering.ts ~L154-158 does path.startsWith(prefix) on the raw string, so riskForPaths(['./server/db/migrations/x.sql']), ['/home/user/V5/server/repos/x.ts'] and ['server\\repos\\x.ts'] all return TIER_1 instead of TIER_3, and testPolicy (mcp/engineeringTools.ts, scripts/engineering.ts) then skips the focused-Postgres requirement for a persistence change. Fix: normalise each path first (backslashes to /, strip leading ./, strip everything through the repository root); an absolute path outside the repo or one climbing with .. is at least TIER_2, never TIER_1; report the normalised path in the reasons.
expectedOutcome: Risk tiers are computed on normalised repository paths and never under-rate an unrecognised path.
nonGoals: Changing tier thresholds or path lists

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/engineeringRiskPaths.test.ts: the three spellings above all return TIER_3.
'../x.ts' returns at least TIER_2 and 'docs/a.md' stays TIER_0.
Existing engineering tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
